# Life OS Design Taste

Status: Draft / Optional

## Purpose

Review UI ideas, screenshots, or component diffs against Life OS V5.

## Sources

- `DESIGN.md`
- `docs/design/dashboard-v5.md`
- `docs/design/design-tokens.md`
- `docs/design/component-system.md`
- `docs/design/anti-ai-slop.md`

## Rules

- V5 is source of truth.
- Do not invent a new design direction.
- Prioritize Today Agenda and Daily Control.
- Reject neon gradients, glass overload, chart flood, and generic AI-slop.
- Color must be semantic and supported by text.
- Accessibility is part of design quality.

## Output

```text
Verdict:
Works:
Issues:
Required changes:
Optional polish:
```
